title: Red Hat Security Advisory: ruby security update
description: A denial of service vulnerability exists in the Ruby resolv gem due to uncontrolled memory growth triggered by crafted DNS responses. This issue affects Ruby as packaged in Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server Extended Life Cycle Support 7. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-80212 and has been rated with a high severity impact by Red Hat Product Security. A security update addressing this issue is available for affected Red Hat products.
